info.name: ilert REST Alert Actions On-Calls API

params.name: policies
params.description: escalation policy ids to filter on call duties for

params.name: policy-levels
params.description: can be provided instead of 'policies', must be a serialised and urlencoded JSON object e.g. ?policy-levels="{ "id": 12, "level": 1 }" where id is the policy id and level is the escalation level that should be included

params.name: schedules
params.description: on call schedule ids to filter on call duties for

params.name: users
params.description: user ids to filter on call duties for

params.name: expand
params.description: include full entities for: policy, escalationPolicy or user

params.name: from
params.description: date-time ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-25T21:24:56.771Z, start of the time range, may not exceed 3 months in total span, defaults to current time

params.name: until
params.description: date-time ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-25T21:24:56.771Z, end of the time range, must be after 'from', defaults to current time

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone in which the results will be rendered, defaults to UTC

params.name: start-index
params.description: offset for the search results, defaults to 0

params.name: max-results
params.description: limit for the search results, defaults to 50, may not exceed 250
